rec.name: Cart Drawer Free-Gift Progress Bar + Cross-sell Carousel
rec.status: Built — delivered to client, tested and approved (Carl Henkel dev theme)

what.text: A bundle of two cart-drawer sections ordered by Sectionfy for Carl Henkel. (1) A progress bar with three milestones (a free-shipping truck icon and two gift icons). It shows a live message such as 'Only €X to go until your free gift!', and below it a 'Free gift' card with the gift product, the label 'Für dich gratis' and an Add button. (2) An up/cross-sell block titled 'Fits perfectly' with the line '8 out of 10 customers also buy', a carousel with arrows, product name and an Add button. Tapping Add on a product with variants opens a bottom-sheet variant picker (image, title, price, size options, full-width 'Add to cart' button).

why.text: The progress bar uses the goal-gradient effect: the closer the shopper gets to a visible reward, the more motivated they are to add to the cart. A free gift is perceived as more valuable than an equivalent discount and increases AOV. The cross-sell block uses a social-proof line ('8 of 10 customers also buy') and a low-friction one-tap add to raise items per order. Showing the gift as clearly free removes price confusion.

how.text: Build as a cart-drawer section/app block in the theme. Compute the gap between cart subtotal and the gift threshold and render the progress fill, milestone icons and message from it. Show a 'Free gift' card with the configured gift product. Add it to the cart at €0 only once the threshold is reached (the Add button appears greyed out before then). In the cart line, the gift's price must NOT be shown (the client was confused by '€50' next to the free gift), and it should be clearly labelled as free. Render the cross-sell as a carousel of recommended products. For products with variants, open a bottom-sheet variant picker with selectable size options, and make sure all variants (e.g. 0.6 l) are selectable. Use the store's body font (Futura) across all new UI. Also reduce spacing in the drawer. The exact implementation is not in the ticket, so this is inferred from the comments and screenshots.

items: Free-gift threshold value (client asked where to set this)
Gift product selection (currently a gift voucher)
Cross-sell heading and social-proof subline text
Cross-sell product source/selection (not specified in ticket)
Variant picker size options and button label
Font family inherited from the theme (Futura)

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with a cart drawer (built in the 'Rework + New Tea Collection [Development]' theme). Requires a gift product (here a gift voucher product) and a cart-subtotal threshold. Needs a source for cross-sell recommendations (Shopify recommendations or manual selection; not specified). The theme font (Futura) must be applied to the new blocks.

items: Share of orders reaching the free-gift threshold
Cross-sell attach rate / items per order
